noAccess: You do not have access to sales in this call centre.
title: Sales
intro: Each sale points to the product template that applied when it was made.
emptyManage: Register the first one with “New sale”. The customer can then accept the offer with BankID or Vipps.
emptyView: Your sales appear here once they are registered.
limit: Showing the latest 200. Use the filter to find older sales.

newSale.needCustomers: You need access to customers to register sales.
newSale.customerHint: Search by name, phone, email or org. no. If the customer does not exist, create it under Customers first.

status.title: Change status
status.final: This ends the sale, and the status cannot be changed later.
status.reasonFinalHint: Feel free to say why. Shown in the history.

confirmations.title: Customer confirmation
confirmations.newLinkConfirm: Create a new link? The previous one will stop working.
confirmations.revokeConfirm: Withdraw the link? The customer will then not be able to respond to it.
confirmations.intro: In telephone sales, the customer is only bound once they accept the offer in writing after the call. The customer receives the offer and the terms, and accepts with BankID or Vipps.
confirmations.sendThis: Send this link to the customer by text message or email:
confirmations.shownOnce: The link is only shown now, and is valid until {date}.
confirmations.mismatch: The name or mobile number does not match the customer. Check that the right person has accepted.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.intro: What was offered, said and accepted. Viewing is logged.
